currency_description.credit: Some actions cost credits. Contact an administrator to top up your balance.
currency_description.diamond: Premium actions — sending SMS and WhatsApp messages, for example — cost diamonds. Contact an administrator to top up your balance.

wallet.adjust_description: Positive grants, negative deducts. The balance can never go below zero.
wallet.donate_confirm: Move this amount into the shared pool? This cannot be undone.
wallet.grant_confirm: Grant this amount from the shared pool to this user?
wallet.grant_description: Move this amount from the site-wide pool into this user’s balance.
wallet.send_confirm: Send this amount? This cannot be undone.
wallet.send_description: Transfer this balance to another user by email. Administrators cannot receive transfers.
wallet.shared_pool_description: The pool belongs to all users — it covers charged actions when someone’s own balance runs out. Move some of your balance into it.
